questions.question: In the 5th period of periodic table sequence of electron filling the subshells-
Reason of lanthanoid contraction is :-
questions.explanation:
Answer - Option(1) 
Explanation - we have to find the correct reason for lanthanoid contraction 
Concept -The lanthanide contraction refers to the gradual decrease in the atomic and ionic sizes of the lanthanide series elements as the atomic number increases, from La (Z = 57) to Lu (Z = 71). 
This phenomenon is primarily due to the ineffective shielding of the increasing nuclear charge by the f-electrons.
